scope: R1b execution, labels, frozen dependencies, numerical controls and evaluation; post-run publishing excluded
resolved_findings: Authenticate seal canonical identity on cached reads
Reject added files in frozen directories
Rehash raw label bytes on each scoped read
Bind executing checkout and plan to archived source
Preserve fixed denominators and NA for failed folds/groups
Evaluate small-step and production views independently
Archive explicit source GGN and paired control decomposition
Count missing observation/dependency failures in completion
limitations: B is development data with prior observation
Empirical KDE is a finite-pool reference
One-step results are exploratory and do not validate a full adaptation loop
